findings.problem: With no hint, 'nosotras' is also a correct answer for 'we' when the group is all female, so the prompt has two right answers.

back.es: we (masculine or mixed group; subject pronoun, also 'us' after a preposition)
back.example: We are going to the movies tonight.

note: The example uses nosotros without contrast, so it does not show the emphatic 'we, not them' use the prompt points to; something like 'Nosotros lo hicimos, no ellos.' would match it better.
